title: Add approval, denial, rollback, and audit command flows
purpose: Make high-risk workflow control usable from terminal commands while preserving exact approval token semantics.
scope: Define CLI flows for approve, deny, timeout/suspend, rollback trigger, audit project, and explain.
Bind approval command input to actor, tool, resource, parameter hash, expiry, and policy version.
Ensure rollback and audit commands use existing runtime state and AuditJournal.
Add negative fixtures for broad approval and parameter mutation.
deliverables: operator approval/denial/rollback/audit command implementation or design
implementation_steps: Add or specify CLI arguments for approval, denial, rollback, audit projection, and explain flows.
Route approval through existing exact token validation.
Add tests or smoke fixtures for denied and mutated approvals.
Record evidence with sample command outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Approval parameter mutation is denied or paused.
Rollback command requires an existing rollback handle.
Audit projection command redacts secret-like summaries.
failure_modes: Rollback can be triggered without a known handle.
